TharwaFx   Website UI and UX bookHow to read this book

How to read this book

Original build

Same broker functions as the blueprint. New layouts, copy and visuals, all in the TharwaFx brand. Nothing suggests a link to another broker.

Arabic-first

Arabic mirrors the whole layout. Latin digits stay in Geist, so prices never fall back to a serif.

Risk always visible

A short warning sits above every page, and the full version in every footer.

Honest placeholders

Square brackets need client input. An asterisk marks a sample trading value. Prices are tagged as samples.

MT5 first

The client holds an MT5 licence, so MT5 is the main platform. cTrader is removed. TradingView shows only once contracted.

Swap-free wording

The Islamic account says "swap-free". "Sharia compliant" needs written certification.

Brand fixes applied

Clear space is half the symbol width
Horizontal lockup added for headers
Tile is black, the app icon has one version
Arabic price labels are fully translated
Unverified rating, volume and speed claims removed
Glow is used on screens only, never in print

Home / Trading / Swap rates

Swap rates

Daily financing for positions held overnight, listed by instrument.

InstrumentLong (points)Short (points)Triple swap day
EURUSD−6.2+2.1Wed
GBPUSD−4.8+1.0Wed
XAUUSD−38.4+14.2Wed
US30−12.9+3.4Fri
USOIL−5.8−1.2Fri

How swap works

Swap is the overnight cost or credit for holding a position past the daily rollover at [time] server time. A triple charge applies once a week to cover the weekend.

Islamic accounts pay no swap on eligible positions.

Sample values, updated daily once connected.

Forex basics, lesson 3 of 12

What a pip is worth

A pip is the fourth decimal place on most currency pairs. If EURUSD moves from 1.1000 to 1.1001, it has moved one pip.

On a standard lot of 100,000 units, one pip is worth about $10. On a micro lot of 1,000 units, it is about $0.10.

Market analysis, [date], 6 min read

What a stronger dollar means for gold this week

Gold usually moves against the dollar. This article explains why, and how to plan around it.

Why the two move apart

Gold is priced in dollars, so a stronger dollar makes it more expensive for buyers in other currencies. Demand can then ease.

This is general market commentary, not investment advice. Past performance does not predict future results.

Margin الهامش

Money set aside to keep a leveraged position open.

Margin call نداء الهامش

A warning that your equity is close to the level needed to hold your positions.

Market order أمر السوق

An order to buy or sell straight away at the best available price.

Micro lot لوت صغير

1,000 units of the base currency, or 0.01 of a standard lot.

How long does verification take?

Most reviews finish within one business day once your documents are clear and complete.

What can slow it down

  • Photos with glare or cut-off edges
  • A proof of address older than three months
  • A name that differs from your profile

Home / Stay safe

Protect yourself from scams

How to spot a fake, and what to do if you see one.

We never ask for your password

Our team will never request your password, 2FA code or card PIN.

We never promise returns

Anyone guaranteeing profit in our name is not from Tharwa.

We use one domain

Only tharwafx.com and our official apps. Check the address every time.

We never message first on WhatsApp

[Confirm official channels with the client.]

Protect your account

Turn on two-step login
Use a unique password
Check login alerts
Review active devices

Report a scam

Tell us about any site, page or person using our name.

Report now

Risk disclosure

Please read this before you open an account. Legal counsel must supply the final text.

Leverage

Leverage lets you hold a large position with a small deposit. A small price move can lead to a large loss, and you can lose more than you deposit.

Market risk

Prices can gap and spreads can widen, especially around news. Orders may fill at a different price from the one you asked for.
